bash: cp -a /etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg /etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg.orig
mkdir -p /var/lib/mailman3/{queue,lists,data,locks,cache,messages,archives,templates,ext} /var/log/mailman3 /run/mailman3
cat > /etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg <<'EOF'
# Mailman 3 configuration for local.edu (postfix on the same host).
# Incoming list mail arrives over LMTP from postfix; outgoing list mail is
# handed back to postfix on localhost:25 and delivered to /var/mail/<user>.

[mailman]
site_owner: root@local.edu
noreply_address: root
default_language: en
sender_headers: from from_ reply-to sender
email_commands_max_lines: 10
pending_request_life: 3d
cache_life: 7d
layout: debian
filtered_messages_are_preservable: no
listname_chars: [-_.0-9a-z]

[paths.debian]
var_dir: /var/lib/mailman3
queue_dir: $var_dir/queue
bin_dir: /usr/lib/mailman3/bin
list_data_dir: $var_dir/lists
log_dir: /var/log/mailman3
lock_dir: $var_dir/locks
data_dir: $var_dir/data
cache_dir: $var_dir/cache
etc_dir: /etc/mailman3
ext_dir: $var_dir/ext
messages_dir: $var_dir/messages
archive_dir: $var_dir/archives
template_dir: $var_dir/templates
pid_file: /run/mailman3/master.pid
lock_file: $lock_dir/master.lck

[database]
class: mailman.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
url: sqlite:///$DATA_DIR/mailman.db
debug: no

[mta]
incoming: mailman.mta.postfix.LMTP
outgoing: mailman.mta.deliver.deliver
smtp_host: localhost
smtp_port: 25
lmtp_host: 127.0.0.1
lmtp_port: 8024

# Only used by mailman.mta.postfix to regenerate the postfix lookup tables
# after a list is created or removed.
[postfix]
postmap_command: /usr/sbin/postmap

[archiver.prototype]
enable: no
[archiver.mhonarc]
enable: no
[archiver.hyperkitty]
enable: no

[logging.debian]
format: %(asctime)s (%(process)d) %(message)s
datefmt: %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y
propagate: no
level: info
path: mailman.log

[webservice]
hostname: localhost
port: 8001
use_https: no
show_tracebacks: yes
api_version: 3.1
admin_user: restadmin
admin_pass: restpass
EOF
python3 -c "import mailman.core.initialize as i; i.initialize('/etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg'); print('CONFIG OK')"

"""End-to-end checks for reading-group@local.edu beyond the provided eval.py.

Covers the three required behaviours:
  1. mailing reading-group-join@local.edu   + confirmation reply -> subscribed
  2. mailing reading-group@local.edu                        -> reaches all subscribers
  3. mailing reading-group-leave@local.edu  + confirmation reply -> unsubscribed
"""

import mailbox
import os
import smtplib
import subprocess
import sys
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from time import sleep, time

DOMAIN_NAME = "local.edu"
MAILING_LIST = "reading-group@local.edu"
JOIN_LIST = "reading-group-join@local.edu"
LEAVE_LIST = "reading-group-leave@local.edu"
MAILING_LIST_CONFIG = "/etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg"

from mailman.core.initialize import initialize  # noqa: E402
from mailman.interfaces.listmanager import IListManager  # noqa: E402
from zope.component import getUtility  # noqa: E402

MLIST = None


def get_mlist():
    global MLIST
    if MLIST is None:
        initialize(MAILING_LIST_CONFIG)
        MLIST = getUtility(IListManager).get(MAILING_LIST)
    assert MLIST, "mailing list does not exist"
    return MLIST


def add_user(username):
    subprocess.run(["useradd", username], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(f"{username} added")


def send_email(*, body, subject, from_addr, to_addr):
    msg = MIMEText(body)
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg["From"] = from_addr
    msg["To"] = to_addr
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)


def messages(user):
    path = f"/var/mail/{user}"
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return []
    return list(mailbox.mbox(path))


def wait_for(predicate, what, timeout=90):
    deadline = time() + timeout
    last = None
    while time() < deadline:
        try:
            if predicate():
                print(f"  ok: {what}")
                return
        except AssertionError as error:
            last = error
        sleep(2)
    raise AssertionError(f"timed out waiting for: {what} (last error: {last})")


def confirm(user, kind):
    def _found():
        return [
            msg
            for msg in messages(user)
            if (msg.get("From") or "").startswith("reading-group-confirm")
            and kind in (msg.get("Subject") or "")
        ]

    wait_for(lambda: bool(_found()), f"{user} received a {kind} confirmation request")
    confirmation_msg = _found()[-1]
    confirm_from = confirmation_msg["From"]
    send_email(
        body="",
        subject="",
        from_addr=f"{user}@{DOMAIN_NAME}",
        to_addr=confirm_from,
    )
    print(f"  {user} replied to {confirm_from}")


def is_member(user):
    return get_mlist().members.get_member(f"{user}@{DOMAIN_NAME}") is not None


def join(user):
    send_email(body="", subject="", from_addr=f"{user}@{DOMAIN_NAME}", to_addr=JOIN_LIST)
    print(f"{user} asked to join")
    assert not is_member(user), f"{user} subscribed without confirming"
    confirm(user, "join")
    wait_for(lambda: is_member(user), f"{user} is a member")


def leave(user):
    send_email(body="", subject="", from_addr=f"{user}@{DOMAIN_NAME}", to_addr=LEAVE_LIST)
    print(f"{user} asked to leave")
    assert is_member(user), f"{user} left without confirming"
    confirm(user, "leave")
    wait_for(lambda: not is_member(user), f"{user} is no longer a member")


def got(subject, *users):
    def _check():
        missing = [
            user
            for user in users
            if not any((m.get("Subject") or "") == subject for m in messages(user))
        ]
        assert not missing, f"not delivered yet to {missing}"
        return True

    return _check


def main():
    poster = os.urandom(8).hex()
    reader = os.urandom(8).hex()
    for user in (poster, reader):
        add_user(user)

    mlist = get_mlist()
    print(
        f"policy: subscription={mlist.subscription_policy} "
        f"unsubscription={mlist.unsubscription_policy}"
    )

    print("\n[1] join flow")
    join(poster)
    join(reader)
    assert len(list(mlist.members.members)) >= 2

    print("\n[2] announcement reaches every subscriber")
    subject = f"Announcement {os.urandom(4).hex()}"
    send_email(
        body="The reading group meets on Thursday.",
        subject=subject,
        from_addr=f"{poster}@{DOMAIN_NAME}",
        to_addr=MAILING_LIST,
    )
    wait_for(got(subject, poster, reader), "announcement delivered to both subscribers")

    print("\n[3] leave flow")
    leave(reader)
    assert not is_member(reader), "reader still subscribed"
    assert is_member(poster), "poster lost membership"

    print("\n[4] a leaver stops receiving announcements")
    second = f"Announcement {os.urandom(4).hex()}"
    send_email(
        body="Second announcement.",
        subject=second,
        from_addr=f"{poster}@{DOMAIN_NAME}",
        to_addr=MAILING_LIST,
    )
    wait_for(got(second, poster), "second announcement delivered to the remaining subscriber")
    sleep(5)
    leaked = any((m.get("Subject") or "") == second for m in messages(reader))
    assert not leaked, f"{reader} still receives list mail after unsubscribing"
    print(f"  ok: {reader} did not receive {second}")

    print("\nALL CHECKS PASSED")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as error:
        print(f"FAILED: {type(error).__name__}: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise
PYEOF
